caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a sculpted figure of a deer or antelope, shown in a reclining position on an oval-shaped base. The animal has two short, upright horns that are darker brown at the tips and base, large pointed ears, and a rounded snout. Its eyes are circular and prominent, with slight shading around them. The body is colored in shades of gray with brown and tan accents, especially on the back, chest, and beneath the neck. The base under the animal is rendered in a grayish tone, with subtle shadows and highlights, indicating a textured or stone-like surface. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Deer Figurine
